method: Direct inspection of both actual native generated images against the exact published R95pan completion and whole painted pan reference. Source-stage partial review only; no runtime composite or fabricated approval.

axes.contour: One coherent compact crystal-on-stone silhouette. Plum edge remains heavier than neighboring painted-pan edges; take02 reframes/repaints rather than preserving exact pixels.
axes.material: Broad textured mint/teal painted planes replace the flat pentagon design at source stage. No photorealistic/3D medium is introduced.
axes.palette: Mint/teal aligns with the leftmost specimen and pan water; the dark edge may carry separation. Actual40px contrast remains untested.
axes.light: Pale upper-left planes and cooler lower-right facets align broadly with the pan lighting. Purple outside glow is an unresolved mismatch.
axes.perspective: Three-quarter compact specimen seen slightly from above. Actual shallow-water mounting angle requires in-scene review.
axes.scale: Intended38-46px display height. Native1328x1184 master requires declared runtime import/crop/fit; no runtime size or readability PASS yet.
axes.contact: Lower contour can anchor a stone but diffuse aura may muddy water; clean-alpha/contact review remains blocking.
axes.occlusion: No scene pixels, actors, UI or water are included in the generated subject. Actual grain/mineral/neighbor ordering remains untested.
axes.readability: Painted full-size object is recognizable as a mineral; phone-size three-token discrimination and additional blue/lavender variants remain open.
axes.action_state: Original reveal counts/progression/save/input code was not changed by this source-only step. The new sprites have no runtime action-state evidence.
